changeSet.comment: nexus.tuple_deliveries: per-(subspace, subscriber, tuple) announce stamp for board posts (bead nexus-q82tk, RDR-213 boards half). CREATE TABLE only, no data mutation of any existing row, so no DATA EFFECT line applies per scripts/data_effect_lint.py's own scope. Consumed by TupleRepository.queryOnceAnnounceSubscriber: a WaitSpec whose announce field names a subscriber returns the rows due for that subscriber and upserts the delivery row in the same transaction. tuple_id cascades from nexus.tuples so the sweep's purge bounds this table. RLS ENABLE+FORCE with tuples-001-1's tenant_isolation policy shape.
